title: In Passing
description: An aerial view of combines harvesting a wheat field in Kansas. Though his work has taken him around the world, photographer and native Kansan Jim Richardson has also spent 40 years capturing life in Cuba, Kansas—a town with less than 200 residents. His photos have been featured in National Geographic numerous times since 1985.
translated_description: 堪萨斯州麦田里，联合收割机正在收割小麦的航拍画面。尽管工作足迹遍布全球，但作为土生土长的堪萨斯人，摄影师吉姆·理查森仍花费40年时间记录堪萨斯州古巴镇（人口不足200人）的生活。自1985年以来，他的照片已多次登上《国家地理》杂志。
